name: SWE-QA-Pro-Pilot
status_note: 16-20 question pilot on a focused 8-10 repository set, NOT a 26-repository sample. Restricted per explicit instruction. 8 repos (qibo, seaborn, sphinx, yt-dlp, pennylane, sqlfluff, sanic, Pillow) were confirmed genuinely used before this pass -- either via the current SWE-QA-Pro adapter's own prior smoke-test runs (qibo, sphinx, sqlfluff, Pillow -- output/runs/smoke-test-sweqa-pro*) or via ANT's own prior architecture-validation ladder work under a different, custom methodology (seaborn, yt-dlp, pennylane, sanic -- output/runs/<repo>-ant-gen0-gen1* and .ant/sweqa/<repo> indexes), disclosed per-repo below. No additional genuinely-previously-run SWE-QA-Pro-protocol repos beyond these 8 were found in local history -- 2 additional repos (web3.py, checkov) were therefore chosen from ALREADY-CLONED repos (repos/) by a pre-specified diversity criterion (new domain not covered by the 8 + size-range extension), NOT by performance. This is a pilot: 2 questions/repo x 10 repos = 20 tasks, selected deterministically by sorted task_id + first-available (cluster, qa_type) diversity pair, without reading gold answers.

new_repo_selection_criterion: Pre-specified, performance-independent: (1) must already be cloned under repos/ (no new clone this pass); (2) must introduce a domain not represented among the 8 confirmed repos (quantum computing/ML, data viz, docs, media, SQL tooling, web framework, image processing); (3) should extend the existing repo-size range (qibo 19K - yt-dlp 226K non-test .py lines) rather than duplicate it. web3.py (36K lines, Ethereum/blockchain client -- a wholly new domain) and checkov (8K lines, infrastructure-as-code security scanning -- also a new domain, and the smallest repo in the combined 10, extending the range below qibo) were selected on this basis alone, before any task_id was drawn or any question read.

baseline_fidelity_closure_addendum: Post-pilot audit (baseline-fidelity closure pass) found a real fidelity defect in the Matched ReAct + RepoGraph baseline: search_repograph was invoked on 0/20 pilot tasks because the official RepoGraph host-agent integration (SWE-agent/config/default.yaml) includes a method-intrinsic usage instruction this suite had omitted (see RepoGraphTool.TOOL_DESCRIPTION and its own FIDELITY AUDIT docstring). After porting that exact instruction (not new/arbitrary prompting), ONLY the matched_react_repograph rows were rerun on the SAME frozen 20 task_ids -- no other method, no task_id, no other baseline changed. Post-fix: search_repograph invoked on 18/20 tasks, mean native score 31.98 -> 33.35. Pre-fix rows preserved verbatim under output/runs/sweqa-pro-pilot-pre-fidelity-fix/ for audit trail. Also confirmed in this same pass: exact pinned per-task repository commits match the official repos.txt and the live dataset commit_id field for every sampled repo (spot-checked qibo, sphinx, Pillow, web3.py, checkov, all exact matches); the official ToolCallingAgent max_iterations=25 comes from its own unmodified eval/configs/models.yaml defaults block, not an injected value; final_answer extraction reads the same "answer" key the official run_agent.py submission path itself reads (trajectory explicitly excluded on both sides); generation cost accounting was added transparently (pure post-hoc computation over already-real token counts, no behavior change) since it had been silently reporting $0.00.
